close_translation: The consciousness's wonder-making (ciccamatkaraṇa), the full-mounting (rūḍha-nirbharā), you, first, flash — that very khecarī (the sky-goer), whose seeking is shown by the form's gathering (rūpa-saṃgraha-darśita-eṣaṇā), by the self-taste-flowing radiance (svarasa-vāhinā tejasā), O Ambikā. *[The khecarī: the consciousness's wonder (camatkāra — the rasa-term), the first flashing, the form-gathering. close_translation: In the inner self (pratyag-ātman), the sight's contraction (dṛśo'vakuñcanā), spreading the world as the food in the belly (viśvam annam udare), devouring (grasya), by the mouth of the retraction (saṃhṛti-mukha) — that very dikcarī (the direction-goer), O Devī, facing the taste's chewing (rasa-carvaṇa-unmukhī). *[The dikcarī: the sight's contraction, the world as the food devoured by the retraction's mouth — the batch's devouring-image (the Kālasaṃkarṣaṇī's consumption) in the goer's form.]*

sanskrit: brahmavigrahakalādhirohiṇī pañcavāhavapuṣaḥ kalā tava | sāmarasyaghaṭitodayā śive śaśvadullasati siddhamaṇḍale

sanskrit: yajjvarādipadamamba vāyunā yā śikhā madhusapannagāspadā | yā niśā madhuniviṣṭasṛṣṭikā paṅktirapyanukaroti te sthitim

close_translation: O Devī, the body called the effect-and-cause (kārya-karaṇa-āhvaya), made of the qualities flowing in the three powers (tri-śakti-visarad-guṇa-ātmakam); the mantra-made, fierce-juice-crowded (māntra-ugra-rasa-saṃkula), the supreme vigor (paraṃ vīryam) — you bring, desiring to take it. *[The effect-and-cause body (the kārya-karaṇa — the Krama's operations), made of the three powers' flowing qualities; the mantra-fierce-juice-crowded supreme vigor brought by the goddess. The report's tri-śakti-dossier: the icchā/jñāna/kriyā.]*

sanskrit: granthayo'pi ṣaḍume yayā dhṛtā sā nirāvaraṇacinnabhaḥpadā | spandamūrtidhṛtabhedaḍambarā bhairavi tvamasi viśvabhedinī
close_translation: The six knots (granthi) too, O Umā [X], held by which — she, of the un-veiled-consciousness-sky station (nirāvaraṇa-cinnabhaḥ-padā); holding the pulse-form's division-uproar (spanda-mūrti-dhṛta-bheda-ḍambarā) — you are the Bhairavī (bhairavi), the divider of the world (viśva-bhedinī). *[The Bhairavī: holding the six knots (granthi — the MNP's granthi-stations, our T1's pañcama udaya's twelve; here the six), of the unveiled-consciousness-sky station, the pulse-form's division-uproar; the world-divider (viśva-bhedinī). The report's krama/kālī dossiers: the Bhairavī as the world's partition and the pulse's holder. The verse is the stotra's doctrinal summit.]*

sanskrit: līḍhamātramukhabheditā tvayā bhūyase janani lelihānayā
close_translation: By you, the licking-up (lelihāna), the face divided (mukha-bheditā) by the mere devouring (līḍha-mātra) — you become more, O mother [X]. *[[X] — "lelihānayā" (the licking image) is the devouring-register's fork; the force: the goddess's devouring divides the face (the goers' mouths), and she grows by it. The batch's devouring-image (the Kālasaṃkarṣaṇī's consumption).]*

sanskrit: tvaṃ parāprabhṛtivaikharāntimollekhavistaravilāpanonmukhī | devyanāvaraṇaśambhusadmagā khecarī bhavasi cidvikāsinī
close_translation: You, from the Parā onward to the Vaikharī's end, facing the dissolution (vilāpana) of the tracing's expansion (ullekha-vistara); going into the unveiled-Śambhu's abode of the goddess (devya-anāvaraṇa-śambhu-sadma), you become the khecarī, the consciousness-expanding (cit-vikāsinī). *[The khecarī's station: the speech-ladder's dissolution (from the parā to the vaikharī — the report's vāc-dossier) faced; the unveiled-Śambhu's abode entered. The khecarī as the consciousness-expansion — the report's khecarī-dossier.]*
provenance: derived from our T1 (working translation, not peer reviewed)

sanskrit: vahnisūryaśaśidhāmaghasmarī kuṇḍalī taḍidivotpatantyasau | śāmbhavaṃ janani bindumadhvanā madhyamena ca gatāsi khecarī
close_translation: The devourer of the fire-sun-moon abodes (vahni-sūrya-śaśi-dhāma-ghasmarī), the kuṇḍalī, leaping like the lightning (taḍid-ivatpatantī) — gone by the drop's path (bindu-madhvanā) and the middle (madhyama), O mother, into the Śāmbhava — you are the khecarī. *[The kuṇḍalī's leap: the fire-sun-moon devouring (the batch's agnīṣoma), the lightning-leap by the drop's and the middle paths into the Śāmbhava. The report's kuṇḍalī/bindu dossiers: the drop's ascent — the same as the MNP's ahalā-kuṇḍalinī (our T1).]*

sanskrit: mudritasvakṛtatattvamaṇḍalā jṛmbhase svajaṭhare sadoditā | vṛndacakragatapañcabhedagā tvaṃ śive diśasi yogajāṃ śriyam
close_translation: With the sealed self-made tattva-circle (mudrita-sva-kṛta-tattva-maṇḍalā), you expand in your own belly (sva-jaṭhare), ever-risen; going into the five-divisions of the host-wheel (vṛnda-cakra-gata-pañca-bheda), O Śiva, you grant the yoga-born glory (yoga-jā śrī). *[The sealed tattva-circle: the self-made world sealed within the goddess's belly; the host-wheel's five divisions; the yoga-born glory granted. The report's tattva-dossier: the thirty-six in the seal.]*

sanskrit: jñānamamba tava bheditaiḥ svaraistaistu yoga iha ṣaṇḍavarjitaiḥ | vyañjanairudayate mahāntikairmantraśaktiyugalaṃ kahādibhiḥ
close_translation: Your knowledge, O mother, by the vowels divided (bhedita-svara); and the yoga here, with the ṣaṇḍa-excluded (ṣaṇḍa-varjita) [X]; with the consonants (vyañjana) arising, the great-near (mahāntika) [X], the mantra-power's pair (mantra-śakti-yugala), with the kahādi (ka-ha-ādi) *[[X] — "ṣaṇḍavarjitaiḥ" and "mahāntikair" are the phoneme-arithmetic's forks; the force: the knowledge by the vowels, the yoga by the consonants, the mantra-power's pair (the mantra and the śakti) with the ka-to-ha series. The report's mātṛkā-dossier: the phonemes' powers.]*

sanskrit: binducakraśaśikuṇḍalī śikhā mūrtirambaragatā caturvidhā | śaktiratra kṛtaśambhubhedanā ṣaṣṭirambaragatāścatuṣparāḥ
close_translation: The drop, the wheel, the moon, the kuṇḍalī, the flame (śikhā) — the form gone into the sky, fourfold (caturvidhā); the power (śakti) here, made the Śambhu-division (kṛta-śambhu-bhedanā); the six (ṣaṣṭi), gone into the sky, the four-supreme (catuṣ-parā) [X]. *[[X] — "catuṣparāḥ" (the four-supreme) is the count's fork; the force: the drop/wheel/moon/kuṇḍalī/flame forms, the fourfold sky-form, the power's Śambhu-division.]*

sanskrit: ādihāntanijadehanirgatāḥ ṣaṣṭiratra caturuttarā rucaḥ | khecarījaṭharaniṣṭhitāstvayā maṅgale paramabhedataḥ kṛtāḥ
close_translation: The sixty-four (ṣaṣṭi-catur-uttarā), gone out from the own body from the ādi to the hānta (ādi-hānta-nija-deha-nirgatā), the shinings (rucaḥ) — placed (niṣṭhitā) in the khecarī's belly (khecarī-jaṭhara), made by you, O auspicious one, by the supreme-division (parama-bhedataḥ). *[The sixty-four phonemes (from the ādi [a] to the hānta [ha] — the mātṛkā's full count) gone out from the goddess's body, placed in the khecarī's belly — the report's mātṛkā-dossier at its fullest: the alphabet as the goddess's body, held by the khecarī.]*

sanskrit: jñānadīdhitiṣu raudradīdhitermantradīdhitiṣu vāmayoditam | yogadīdhitiṣu jṛmbhate'mbikā jyeṣṭhayaivamatha śaktidīdhiteḥ
close_translation: In the knowledge-rays (jñāna-dīdhiti), of the fierce-ray (raudra-dīdhiti); in the mantra-rays, risen by the left (vāmaya); in the yoga-rays expands (jṛmbhate) the Ambikā — by the Jeṣṭhā, thus, then the power-ray (śakti-dīdhiti) *[The four rays: the knowledge, the fierce (raudra), the mantra, the yoga — the Ambikā expanding in them by the Jeṣṭhā. The report's śakti-dossier: the powers' rays.]*

sanskrit: devyabheditakalācatuṣṭayā śambhudīdhitiṣu dīpyate svaraḥ | tatsthitistvamapi varṇabhedinī maṅgale vahasi yatpradhānatām
close_translation: By the goddess, the un-divided four-phonemed (abhedita-kalā-catuṣṭayā), in the Śambhu-rays shines the vowel (svara); its stay (tat-sthiti), you too, the phoneme-divider (varṇa-bhedinī), O auspicious one, bear the primacy (pradhānatām). *[The four-phonemed vowel (the kāmakalā's triad + the bindu?) shining in the Śambhu-rays; the goddess, the phoneme-divider, bearing the primacy. The report's mātṛkā/kāmakalā dossiers.]*

sanskrit: sarvadaiva sakṛdāsthitodayāḥ sarvataḥ kṣapitakalpanābhidāḥ | itthamekavapuṣā tvayā nijāḥ sphāritā mahati lakṣmacittviṣaḥ
close_translation: Always, once-seated risings (sakṛd-āsthita-udayāḥ), on all sides, with the destroyed-imagination names (kṣapita-kalpanā-abhidāḥ) — thus, by the one-body (eka-vapus), by you, the own [rays], expanded in the great — the mark, the consciousness-rays (lakṣma-cit-tviṣaḥ) [X]. *[[X] — "lakṣmacittviṣaḥ" (the mark's consciousness-rays) is the obscure close; the force: the once-risen, imagination-destroyed rays, expanded by the goddess's one body. The report's saṃvit-dossier: the consciousness-rays.]*

sanskrit: udyamaprathanacarvaṇātmakaṃ jāgarādipadamamba yatkriyā | yatturīyamapi tadvilāpanaṃ bhātanustvamakhile'tra jṛmbhase
close_translation: The station of the waking-and-the-rest (jāgara-ādi-pada), whose nature is the effort, the first, the chewing (udyama-prathana-carvaṇa), O mother — the action (kriyā); what is the fourth (turīya) too, its dissolution (vilāpana); the being-body (bhāta-tanu), you expand here in all. *[The waking-stations (the jāgara-ādi — the report's jñāna-bhūmikā) as the action; the fourth's dissolution; the being-body's expansion. The same four-and-beyond as the MNP's levels (our T1).]*

sanskrit: yo vikalparahito'kṣamaṇḍalārūḍha ullasati māturambike | prāgvimarśa iha tanmukhī prathā jñānamarthavidhṛtā tanustava
close_translation: He who, free of the vikalpa (vikalpa-rahita), mounted on the senses-wheel (akṣa-maṇḍala-ārūḍha), shines — O mother, O Ambikā — the prior reflexion (prāg-vimarśa) here, facing it (tan-mukhī), the manifestation (prathā) — the knowledge (jñāna), the body holding the object (artha-vidhṛtā tanu), yours. *[The vikalpa-free reflexion: the senses-wheel-mounted shining, the prior reflexion (prāg-vimarśa) as the knowledge-body holding the object. The report's vimarśa-dossier: the reflexion as the knowledge's form.]*

sanskrit: īdṛgetaditi tatprathāsthiteryo vimarśa udito'ntarakṣataḥ | mantra eṣa tava vṛndacakrago yanmukhī bhavati tāvakī kriyā
close_translation: "Of such kind is this" (īdṛg etad iti) — of that manifestation's stay, the reflexion (vimarśa) risen from the inner (antarakṣataḥ); this mantra (mantra), of you, going in the host-wheel (vṛnda-cakra); by which it faces (mukhī), your action (kriyā) becomes. *[The "such is this" reflexion as the mantra: the determination (the exclusion — the report's apoha-dossier) risen inner, going in the host-wheel, becoming the goddess's action. The īdṛg-iti (the "such-is-this") — the determinacy's moment.]*

sanskrit: bhogyabhoktṛparighaṭṭanollasannirmalapramadanirbharodayā | lolitākhilahṛṣīkavṛttikā yuktiramba ! tava viśvamelinī
close_translation: Risen full of the stainless-passion (nirmala-pramada-nirbhara) flashing in the churning of the enjoyed-and-enjoyer (bhogya-bhoktṛ-parighaṭṭana), the activities of all the senses set-a-swing (lolita-akhila-hṛṣīka-vṛttikā) — the method (yukti), O mother, yours, the world-mingler (viśva-melinī). *[The world-mingling method: the enjoyed-enjoyer's churning, the stainless-passion's rise, all the senses' activities set swinging — the yukti as the goddess's world-mingling. The report's ānanda-dossier: the stainless-passion (pramada) as the equal-taste's fuel.]*

sanskrit: jñaptimātramapanītavāsanaṃ nirvikalpamadhiruhya cittviṣā | sāmarasyakṛtaśāśvatodayā tvaṃ hi śaktiradhitiṣṭhasīśvare
close_translation: Mounting the mere-apprehension (jñapti-mātra), the impression-removed (apanīta-vāsanam), the vikalpa-free (nirvikalpa) — the consciousness-ray (cit-tviṣā); the equal-taste-made eternal rising (sāmarasya-kṛta-śāśvatodayā) — you, indeed, the power (śakti), superintend the Lord (īśvara). *[The superintending power: the mere-apprehension, impression-free, vikalpa-free, mounted; the equal-taste's eternal rising; the power superintending the Lord. The report's śakti-dossier: the power as the Lord's superintendence.]*

sanskrit: śūnyamamba gaganaṃ hi yā mahat spandabījamaniketamīyuṣī | līyase jhaṭiti cittayā tvayā śambhuraśmivapuṣā'tra bhūyate
close_translation: The great void-sky (śūnya-gagana), O mother, the pulse-seed (spanda-bīja), attaining the without-abode (aniketa) — you dissolve (līyase) at once, by the consciousness-ray, by you, the Śambhu, of the ray-body (raśmi-vapus), becomes here. *[The pulse-seed's dissolution: the void-sky (the report's śūnya-dossier), the spanda-bīja, the without-abode; the goddess dissolving, the Śambhu becoming of the ray-body. The spanda as the seed — the report's spanda-dossier.]*

sanskrit: jñānamamba śamapūrṇacitpayorāśilambilaharī tvamucyase | tadvimarśatadupāśritakramadhvaṃsamūrtiśatamūrdhvamaṇḍalā
close_translation: The knowledge, O mother, the wave (laharī) hanging on the ocean of the peace-filled consciousness (śama-pūrṇa-cit-payo-rāśi) — you are called; its reflexion (tad-vimarśa), resting on it, the order's destruction (upāśrita-krama-dhvaṃsa), the hundred-headed form (śata-mūrdha-maṇḍalā), the upper-circle (ūrdhva-maṇḍalā) [X]. *[The knowledge-wave: hanging on the peace-filled consciousness-ocean (the waveless — the MNP's "nistaraṅga-śiva-cit-payonidhi," our T1's tṛtīya udaya); the reflexion, the order's destruction (krama-dhvaṃsa — the report's krama-rule), the hundred-headed upper-circle.]*

sanskrit: styāyamānaśivacidrasātmakaṃ bhāvavṛndamadhiruhya bhāmayī | khānilāgnijalabhūmibhāsinī śambhutaḥ prabhṛti jṛmbhase śive
close_translation: The being-host (bhāva-vṛnda) made of the thickening Śiva-consciousness-juice (styāyamāna-śiva-cid-rasa-ātmaka), mounting — the light-formed (bhāmayī); shining in the sky, the wind, the fire, the water, the earth (kha-anila-agni-jala-bhūmi-bhāsinī), from the Śambhu on, you expand, O Śiva. *[The element-shining: the being-host as the thickening consciousness-juice (the same styāna-image as the Mahārthamañjarī's g.25, "the thickening," our R1's note); the goddess shining in the five elements from the Śambhu on.]*

sanskrit: sphāratāvakavimarśapāvakabhrāmyamāṇadhanasārabhātmikāḥ | pañcadivyakulabījavigrahāḥ tvattviṣo'mba ! śivacinnabhaḥpradāḥ
close_translation: The essence-being made of the gold (dhana-sāra-bhā) whirled in the fire of your reflexion (tvad-vimarśa-pāvaka), the five-divine-kula-seeds' forms (pañca-divya-kula-bīja-vigrahāḥ) — your rays, O mother, the givers of the Śiva-consciousness-sky (śiva-cinnabhaḥ-pradāḥ). *[The gold-in-the-fire: the being's essence whirled in the reflexion's fire (the alchemical image — the gold's refinement); the five divine-kula seeds (the pañca — the batch's five); the rays giving the Śiva-consciousness-sky.]*

sanskrit: pañcacakratanureṣa jṛmbhate nirvikalpaśivabodhasatphalaḥ | pañcasu kramamahīruhaḥ śive tvanmarīciṣu nirastavaibhavam
close_translation: This five-wheel-body (pañca-cakra-tanu) expands, the true-fruit of the vikalpa-free-Śiva-awareness (nirvikalpa-śiva-bodha-satphala); in the five, the order's great-tree (krama-mahīruhaḥ), O Śiva, in your rays (tvan-marīciṣu), the glory cast-off (nirasta-vaibhavam) [X]. *[[X] — "nirastavaibhavam" (the glory cast-off) is the obscure close; the force: the five-wheel body as the vikalpa-free-awareness's true fruit; the order's great-tree in the rays. sanskrit: bījamamba ! tava pañcadhoditasphāritapraguṇadevatākramaḥ | siddhido'yamaparītajṛmbhaṇo yaḥ prakāśa iha so'ntacakragaḥ
close_translation: The seed (bīja), O mother, your fivefold-risen, expanded, the excellent deity-order (praguṇa-devatā-krama); this siddhi-giver (siddhidaḥ), of the un-enclosed expansion (aparīta-jṛmbhaṇa), which is the light (prakāśa) here — that, going in the inner-wheel (anta-cakra-gaḥ) *[The seed's order: the fivefold-risen deity-order (the krama as the deity's sequence — the report's rule); the siddhi-giving light in the inner-wheel. The batch's bīja-dossier: the seed-phonemes.]*

sanskrit: śambhudhāmni patitāmbareśvarī śaktidhāmani tato'nu khecarī | bhūcarī tvamanu yogadhāmnyato dikcarī tadanu mantradhāmani
close_translation: In the Śambhu-abode (śambhu-dhāman) the sky-lady (ambareśvarī) fallen [X]; in the power-abode (śakti-dhāman), then, the khecarī; the bhūcarī, then, in the yoga-abode (yoga-dhāman); from there the dikcarī, then, in the mantra-abode (mantra-dhāman) *[The goers' stations: the ambareśvarī in the Śambhu-abode, the khecarī in the power-abode, the bhūcarī in the yoga-abode, the dikcarī in the mantra-abode — the five abodes' map. The report's khecarī-dossier: the goers' hierarchy.]*

sanskrit: pañcamaṃ jhaṭiti pātukakramādīyuṣī sphurasi raudravaibhavāt | jñānadhāmni nikhileśi gocarī na kramastava nirāśraye pade
close_translation: The fifth, at once, by the falling-order (pātuka-krama) [X], attaining, you flash from the fierce-glory (raudra-vaibhava); in the knowledge-abode (jñāna-dhāman), O all-lady (nikhileśi), the gocarī — there is no order (krama) of yours in the unsupported station (nirāśraya-pade). *[The fifth goer: the gocarī in the knowledge-abode, flashing from the fierce-glory; the no-order (na krama) in the unsupported station — the report's krama-rule's negative: beyond the sequence, in the unsupported. The pātuka-krama (the falling-order) [X] — the descent's fork.]*

sanskrit: jñānataḥ prabhṛti pañcamaṃ śive yat tvamatra paracinnabhastanuḥ | pañcavāhamayaśaktigarbhiṇī bhāsase prathanaketaghasmarī
close_translation: From the knowledge on, the fifth, O Śiva, what you are here — the supreme-consciousness-sky body (para-cinnabha-tanu); the five-power-made-power-pregnant (pañca-vāha-maya-śakti-garbhiṇī) — you shine, the devourer of the first-mark (prathana-keta-ghasmarī) [X]. *[The fifth's body: the supreme-consciousness-sky, the five-power-pregnant (the pañca-vāha — the MNP's term), shining as the devourer. sanskrit: tvaṃ nirantaracidambarātmikā velayā'mba tulitā dayāmbugheḥ | tvayyamūrjhaṭiti saṃvidāpagāḥ pūrṇatāṃ dadhati nirniketanāḥ
close_translation: You, of the unceasing-consciousness-sky nature (nirantara-cid-ambara-ātmikā), by the shore (velayā), O mother, weighed (tulitā) with the compassion-ocean (dayā-ambudheḥ); in you, at once, by the consciousness (saṃvidā), the rivers (āpagāḥ) attain the fullness (pūrṇatām), the without-abode (nirniketanāḥ) [X]. *[[X] — the "weighed with the compassion-ocean" (the grace's measure) and the "rivers attaining fullness" (the senses' fulfillment?) are the obscure registers; the force: the goddess's compassion-ocean, the consciousness filling the streams.]*

close_translation: Fivefold, the begun-glory (prabhṛta-vaibhava), O Śiva, this wheel, here, made-gocarī (gocarī-kṛtam) [X]. *[[X] — "gocarīkṛtam" (made-gocarī — made into the sense-field-goer?) is the obscure close; the force: the wheel's fivefold glory, made into the goer. sanskrit: dhāma yad bhavati mudrayā samaṃ yā ca saṃvidaniketanāśraye | yā'ṇubhāvakalitā kalā ca tat sarvamamba tava bṛndacakragam
close_translation: The abode (dhāma) which becomes equal with the mudrā (mudrayā samam); and the cognition (saṃvid) in the without-abode's support (aniketana-āśraye); and the phoneme (kalā) made the minute-being (aṇubhāva-kalitā) — all that, O mother, goes into your host-wheel (vṛnda-cakra). *[The host-wheel's gathering: the abode, the cognition, the phoneme — all gathered into the goddess's host-wheel.
